## Checklist

- [ ] I reviewed my own changes and commented complex or critical parts.
- [ ] I added or updated tests that cover the change, where applicable.
- [ ] Tests and linters pass locally.
- [ ] I updated the documentation (for example the module's `README.md`)

- [ ] The title follows the Conventional Commits
  [title format](https://github.com/gofiber/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#pull-request-titles),
